description:
Batman: Arkham Asylum - Tales of Madness #1 (May 1998), DC Comics - Cataclysm part 16. Alan Grant story, Dave Taylor cover and art: the Joker, the Riddler and the Scarecrow loose in Arkham after the Gotham earthquake. Newsstand edition (barcode), $2.95 cover price.

Back cover: Gap ad.

Condition: bright with light handling wear; light soiling on the back cover (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
